text:
alex: Heads-up — we need a quick hotfix for 2.1.1 -> 2.1.2 for the model cache index mismatch affecting Dedicated customers. Target cutover in ~2h, aim for minimal diff and no UX changes. PR #4218 is the fix.

maya: ack, what's the rollback plan if smoke fails?

alex: rollback = cut traffic to fallback variant + revert cherry-pick on release branch, will keep old docker tag around. low-risk but want extra eyes on smoke tests.

samir: I'm on it. prepping cherry-pick and smoke test matrix. planning to keep commit footprint <5 LOC. will open the release PR after cherry-pick.

andrea: tiny changelog nudge — please add one-line note under 2.1.2 (bugfix: model cache index). I can merge changelog once PR is green.

samir: cherry-pick commands to use:
```
git checkout release/2.1
git pull origin release/2.1
git cherry-pick --no-verify 7f2a9b3
# verify tests locally: make smoke-fast
```
commit sha: 7f2a9b3 (from main). PR will be 4220 (release branch PR with cherry-pick).

jordan: sharing quick smoke checklist:
- deploy to staging-release-2.1
- run `make smoke-fast` and `curl /health` 20x
- run a small KV cache load scenario (script in infra/tests/cache_load.sh)
- verify latency P99 doesn't regress >50ms
If all green we promote.

alex: timeline: cherry-pick + CI ~15m, smoke ~20m, cut + verify ~10m. slack nudge 30m before cut.

release-bot: CI pipeline triggered for PR #4220 — status: pending. (auto)

ci-bot: PR #4220 — build passed, unit tests passed, integration tests queued.

samir: CI green for unit + integration. kicking off smoke on staging-release-2.1 now.

andrea: changelog updated in the PR with the one-line note, ping me to merge after CI green.

jordan: smoke results: all checks passed, cache_load script completed, no errors in logs. latency P99 +20ms.

maya: nice. I can do the cut when you give the go. I will also prepare the rollback revert branch in case.

alex: go for cut in 5. I'll post the traffic switch procedure in the runbook channel and will monitor.

release-bot: Release window started for 2.1.2-hotfix at 1949999999. Automated backups in progress.

ci-bot: deploy to staging-release-2.1 succeeded. E2E smoke passed.

samir: performing the cherry-pick merge to release/2.1 -> creating release tag v2.1.2-hotfix.

andrea: merging changelog and tagging PR after you create the tag.

jordan: post-deploy quick checks done: /health all OK, kv cache stats normal, no error spike.

maya: traffic switched to v2.1.2-hotfix on dedicated pool. Monitoring for 15m.

alex: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. follow-ups: write short incident note if anything odd, and we'll schedule backport to any other maintained branches if needed.

samir: leaving a short postmortem comment in the PR about root cause and next steps (improve cache-index validation).

release-bot: Release completed: v2.1.2-hotfix rolled out to dedicated. All automated checks passed.

ci-bot: deploy markers: build-7682, tag v2.1.2-hotfix.

maya: marking this thread resolved. thanks for the quick turnaround. :rocket:
